descriptionFull: The Atlantic puffin ( Fratercula arctica ), also known as the common puffin , is a species of seabird in the auk family. It is the only puffin native to the Atlantic Ocean; two related species, the tufted puffin and the horned puffin, are found in the northeastern Pacific.
